rows.label: qst650201_msg0001
rows.name: Dad, I'm home, mo!

rows.label: qst650201_msg0002
rows.name:
I got word that a letter arrived for
me, mo.

rows.label: qst650201_msg0003
rows.name: That's right, mo.

rows.label: qst650201_msg0004
rows.name:
It's a strange letter. The sender
didn't write a name, mo.

rows.label: qst650201_msg0005
rows.name: Suspicious, mooo...

rows.label: qst650201_msg0006
rows.name:
What's inside is even more suspicious,
mo. I'll read a bit of it, mo.

rows.label: qst650201_msg0007
rows.name: Let's see, mo...

rows.label: qst650201_msg0008
rows.name: "To... Tora..."

rows.label: qst650201_msg0009
rows.name:
The handwriting is so bad I already
don't feel like reading, mo...

rows.label: qst650201_msg0010
rows.name:
I'm sure whoever wrote this is a
stupid, useless Nopon, but you should
put up with it and keep reading, mo.

rows.label: qst650201_msg0011
rows.name: All right, mo...

rows.label: qst650201_msg0012
rows.name: "To Tora..."

rows.label: qst650201_msg0013
rows.name: "The following... Blade..."

rows.label: qst650201_msg0014
rows.name:
"After... making Hana... gather the
data..."

rows.label: qst650201_msg0015
rows.name: "In Superbia..."

rows.label: qst650201_msg0016
rows.name: "Come... to Bulge Harbor..."

rows.label: qst650201_msg0017
rows.name: I don't really get this letter.

rows.label: qst650201_msg0018
rows.name:
Could it be someone Tora and Hana
know?

rows.label: qst650201_msg0019
rows.name:
You said the sender's unknown, but
does anyone come to mind?

rows.label: qst650201_msg0020
rows.name:
I don't know any Nopon who writes this
badly, mo!

rows.label: qst650201_msg0021
rows.name:
But if they know about Tora and Hana,
they must be someone we know, mo...

rows.label: qst650201_msg0022
rows.name: Master, are you curious, mo?

rows.label: qst650201_msg0023
rows.name: Of course! How could I not be, mo?

rows.label: qst650201_msg0024
rows.name:
Well then, why don't we just try
doing what the letter says?

rows.label: qst650201_msg0025
rows.name: Really, mo?

rows.label: qst650201_msg0026
rows.name: Of course!

rows.label: qst650201_msg0027
rows.name:
Gathering Blade data should be quick
with all of us here!

rows.label: qst650201_msg0028
rows.name:
I think we should hear the details
before deciding...

rows.label: qst650201_msg0029
rows.name:
The handwriting's awful, but I'll try
reading it, mo.

rows.label: qst650201_msg0030
rows.name:
"Data on Beam Blast, the Special of an
ordinary girl-type Blade who uses a
Cannon."

rows.label: qst650201_msg0031
rows.name:
"Data on Assault Rush, the Special of
an ordinary boy-type Blade who uses
Knuckles."

rows.label: qst650201_msg0032
rows.name:
"Data on Dual Fang, the Special of an
ordinary dog-type Blade who uses Twin
Rings."

rows.label: qst650201_msg0033
rows.name:
"Data on Tomahawk Boomerang, the
Special of an ordinary boy-type Blade
who uses an Axe."

rows.label: qst650201_msg0034
rows.name:
"Data on Aerial Shield, the Special of
an ordinary girl-type Blade who uses a
Hammer."

rows.label: qst650201_msg0035
rows.name:
"Data on Flash Bomb, the Special of an
ordinary girl-type Blade who uses a
Ball."

rows.label: qst650201_msg0036
rows.name:
"Data on Beam Halberd, the Special of
an ordinary burly-type Blade who uses
a Lance."

rows.label: qst650201_msg0037
rows.name:
"Data on Multi-Raid, the Special of an
ordinary boy-type Blade who uses a
Katana."

rows.label: qst650201_msg0038
rows.name:
It says we need these eight pieces of
data, mo.

rows.label: qst650201_msg0039
rows.name: That's a lot...

rows.label: qst650201_msg0040
rows.name: But Boss said we'd give it a try, mo?

rows.label: qst650201_msg0041
rows.name: Ugh...

rows.label: qst650201_msg0042
rows.name: Fine! I'm a man too! I'll do it all!

rows.label: qst650201_msg0043
rows.name:
Just as expected of Boss! A man among
men, mo!

rows.label: qst650201_msg0044
rows.name:
Well... Rex doesn't have to shoulder
this alone.

rows.label: qst650201_msg0045
rows.name: Nia and I will help too.

rows.label: qst650201_msg0046
rows.name:
Meleph is a man among men too, mo! If
the Drivers work together, we'll be
done in no time, mo!

rows.label: qst650201_msg0048
rows.name: A-anyway, let's give it a try.

rows.label: qst650201_msg0049
rows.name:
Once we're done, we just go to Bulge
Harbor in Superbia, right?

rows.label: qst650201_msg0050
rows.name:
That's what it said, mo. There are a
lot, so let's split them up and do
them in order, mo!

rows.label: qst650201_msg0051
rows.name: Well then, Dad, I'm off, mo.

rows.label: qst650201_msg0052
rows.name:
We don't know what kind of suspicious
Nopon might be waiting for us, so
we'll be careful, mo.

rows.label: qst650201_msg0101
rows.name: "To Tora..."

rows.label: qst650201_msg0102
rows.name:
"After having Hana gather the
following Blade data..."

rows.label: qst650201_msg0103
rows.name: "After having Hana gather the data"

rows.label: qst650201_msg0104
rows.name: "Then go to Bulge Harbor in Superbia."
